result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the featured 'Popular right now' restaurant name is hard-clipped where it meets the rating, and the favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The restaurant title in the first 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Ramei' — the text is cut off mid-character (no ellipsis) where it collides with the right-aligned star rating '4.8 (500+)'. This is a full-width vertical card, not a horizontal carousel, so the truncation is a real layout bug.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with the rating in a fixed-width sibling (flex row with min-width:0 and text-overflow: ellipsis on the title), or wrap the title to a second line so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The favourite heart button on the ramen card uses a white/light circular background with a dark outline, while the heart button on the pizza card below uses a dark/black circular background. The inconsistent treatment makes the second button low-contrast and looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button styling (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with a white heart) across all cards so it is consistently visible over any image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a very light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually inconsistent and the light image appear unloaded/placeholder-like.
issues.suggestion: Normalise image backgrounds or apply a consistent overlay/gradient behind the time badge so all carousel thumbnails read as the same type of content.
